subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
text:
A3708/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2610080500  C) 2610270900  E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
FURTHER TO GREEK NOTAM A3697/26 (061219 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) ON TURKISH
NAVY AND AIRFORCE EXERCISE AND REFERRING TO TURKISH NOTAM A4506/26  
(070729 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) WE STATE THE FOLLOWING:
- THE ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS MENTIONED IN PARAGRAPHS 4.2 AND 4.3
OF THE GREEK NOTAM A3697/26 AIM AT:
1. THE PROMOTION OF SAFETY, REGULARITY AND EFFICIENCY OF
INTERNATIONAL AIR NAVIGATION AND THE AVOIDANCE OF INTERCEPTION OF
EXERCISE AIRCRAFT FOR IDENTIFICATION PURPOSES IN CONFORMITY WITH
ARTICLE 3 (D) OF THE ICAO CONVENTION ON INTERNATIONAL CIVIL AVIATION
AS AMPLIFIED BY THE A40-04 ICAO ASSEMBLY RESOLUTIONS, APPENDIX I,
RESOLVING  CLAUSE 2, SEE ALSO THE ANNEX 2 TO THE ICAO CONVENTION ON
INTERNATIONAL CIVIL AVIATION AS WELL AS ARTICLE 12 OF THE ICAO
CONVENTION AND THE ESTABLISHED INTERNATIONAL PRACTICE.
2. THE PREVENTION OF ANY MISUNDERSTANDING WITH REGARD TO THE WIDTH
OF THE NATIONAL AIRSPACE OF GREECE.
THEREFORE, TURKISH NOTAM A4506/26 (070729 EUECYIYN OCT 2026)
IS CONSIDERED NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/
HELLAS UIR.
THE ONLY VALID NOTAM FOR THE TURKISH NAVY AND AIRFORCE EXERCISE
WITHIN ATHINAI FIR IS THE ABOVE END PART 1 OF 2
A3708/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2610080500  C) 2610270900  E) MENTIONED A3697/26 NOTAM ISSUED BY 
GREECE. END PART 2 OF 2
